gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Please carry ___ with your work; don't mind me.
gaps.explanation: carry on = continue; carry out = perform (a task).

gaps.sentence: We're trying to get rid ___ these old boxes.
gaps.explanation: get rid OF something = remove it.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The match was called ___ because of the storm.
We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.
